mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a potential monetary policy misalignment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.
